modalities.evidence: BOLD data were collected eyes open at rest

output.population: 89 subject datasets, collected from consenting neurotypical subjects with standard inclusion/exclusion criteria (English speaking, right handed, no history of neurological or psychiatric illness)
output.summary: Resting-state multi-echo BOLD data and T1-weighted anatomical images from 89 neurotypical subjects, acquired eyes open on a Siemens Trio 3T scanner with 4 echoes in a single multi-echo run.
